summary: A reporter with a speech in hand still walks out to hear what the speaker adds.
realLife: Irving Perlmeter said reporters on the campaign train often listened at the platform despite receiving advance copy because Truman might add an unscripted remark.
inGame: needs: advance copy and access to the public remarks.

turns.pulledBy: The reporter hears a new observation.
turns.what: They record it alongside the printed draft.
turns.writesBack: The account includes what the crowd actually heard.
